items.title: Unit 6 · Story
items.scene: I paint a ___ with a belt and a queen in a long, pink robe.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: I paint a king with a belt and a queen in a long, pink robe.
items.storyText: I can paint a picture by hand. I paint grass and a tree. I paint the sky, too. The grass is green, and the sky is blue. I paint a king with a belt and a queen in a long, pink robe. Then I paint a camp with three tents and a lamp. I paint the wind. It blows the camp. It blows the king and queen, too. Oh, no!
items.why: In “My Picture”, you hear: I paint a king with a belt and a queen in a long, pink robe. The missing word is “king”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 6, p.59 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
